fullPassage: For thousands of years, China’s northern regions, above the Yangtze River, primarily produced wheat, while the southern regions mainly produced rice. This discrepancy, behavioral scientist Thomas Talhelm suggests, may account for why northerners tend to be more individualistic and controlling of their environment than southerners. Talhelm examined the behavior of café patrons in six Chinese cities and found that people from the north were more likely to sit alone than people from the south and that when chairs were partially blocking aisles, northerners were more likely to move them than southerners, who responded by squeezing around them. He theorized that the southerners were more willing to sit in groups and adjust themselves to the environment due to the historically labor-intense experience of rice production, which often required community members to cooperate closely for tasks such as building irrigation canals. Wheat production, on the other hand, required far less work and communal effort, and this may have fostered a more independent mindset.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: was → were (주어 people from the north가 복수)
det.analysis:
① produced ✅ 적절 — 복수주어 regions에 맞는 과거동사

② was ❌ 오류 — 주어가 'people from the north(북부 사람들)'로 복수예요. 중간에 낀 'from the north'에 속으면 안 돼요. 복수주어에는 were가 와야 하므로 was는 틀려요 ←정답

③ adjust ✅ 적절 — 'willing to sit ... and (to) adjust'로 앞의 to sit과 병렬을 이루는 동사원형

④ building ✅ 적절 — 전치사구 such as 뒤의 동명사
det.tip: 핵심 주어를 찾자. people(복수) → were. 주어와 동사 사이 수식어(from the north)에 속지 말기

det.korean: whom → who (뒤에 동사 responded가 이어지는 주격 관계대명사)
det.analysis:
① controlling ✅ 적절 — 'individualistic and controlling'의 병렬

② were ✅ 적절 — 복수주어 people에 맞는 과거동사

③ whom ❌ 오류 — 관계사 바로 뒤에 동사 responded가 이어져요. 뒤에 동사가 오면 주어 역할을 하는 '주격' 관계대명사 who를 써야 해요. whom은 목적어 자리에 쓰는 목적격이라 틀려요 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ reluctant(꺼리는)는 원문 willing(기꺼이 하는)과 반대로, 남부가 무리 지어 앉기를 '기꺼이' 한다는 문맥과 모순
det.analysis:
① produced(생산했다) ✅ 적절 — 북부가 밀을 생산함

② controlling(통제하려는) ✅ 적절 — 북부 사람들이 환경을 통제하려는 성향

③ move(옮기다) ✅ 적절 — 북부 사람들은 막힌 의자를 옮기는 편

④ reluctant(꺼리는) ❌ 부적절 — 글은 남부 사람들이 무리 지어 앉고 환경에 순응하기를 '기꺼이(willing)' 한다고 해요. reluctant(꺼리는)는 정반대라 문맥에 안 맞아요 ←정답
det.tip: 남부는 집단적으로 앉기를 기꺼이(willing) 함. reluctant(꺼림)는 논리상 반대

det.korean: ② yielding(순응하는)은 원문 controlling(통제하려는)과 반대로, 북부가 환경을 '통제하려는' 성향이 강하다는 문맥과 모순
det.analysis:
① primarily(주로) ✅ 적절 — 북부의 주된 작물이 밀

② yielding(순응하는) ❌ 부적절 — 글은 북부 사람들이 개인주의적이고 환경을 '통제하려는(controlling)' 성향이 강하다고 해요. yielding(순응하는)은 오히려 남부의 성향이라 문맥에 안 맞아요 ←정답

③ alone(혼자) ✅ 적절 — 북부 사람들은 혼자 앉는 편

④ labor-intense(노동 집약적인) ✅ 적절 — 쌀 재배의 노동 집약적 특성
det.tip: 북부=환경을 통제(controlling). yielding(순응)은 남부 성향이라 반대

det.korean: sit alone=혼자 앉다
det.analysis:
빈칸은 '북부 사람들이 남부 사람들보다 더 하기 쉬운 행동'이고, 뒤에서 남부 사람들은 '무리 지어 앉는다(sit in groups)'고 대비돼요. 개인주의적 성향의 북부라면 혼자 앉는 sit alone(혼자 앉다)이 적절해요

det.korean: ② 의자 주위로 비집고 지나간 쪽은 북부가 아니라 '남부' 사람들이었음

③ 일치 — 'examined the behavior of café patrons in six Chinese cities'

④ 일치 — 'the historically labor-intense experience of rice production'
det.tip: move them(옮김)=북부, squeezing around(비집고 지나감)=남부. 주체를 바꾼 오답

ch: 북부 지역은 오랫동안 밀을, 남부 지역은 쌀을 주로 재배했다.

questions.passage: For thousands of years, China’s northern regions, above the Yangtze River, primarily produced wheat, while the southern regions mainly produced rice. This discrepancy, behavioral scientist Thomas Talhelm suggests, may account for why northerners tend to be more individualistic and controlling of their environment than southerners. Talhelm examined the behavior of café patrons in six Chinese cities and found that people from the north were more likely to sit alone than people from the south and that when chairs were partially blocking aisles, northerners were more likely to move them than southerners, who responded by squeezing around them. He theorized that the southerners were more willing to sit in groups and adjust themselves to the environment due to the historically labor-intense experience of rice production, which often required community members to cooperate closely for tasks such as building irrigation canals. Wheat production, on the other hand, required far less work and communal effort, and this may have fostered a more independent mindset.
